metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a sealed book, seven shillings counted down, and the deposing told to Richard at the stage door.

yesterday: Tilney cut the deposing from the public book. York may bring word of it.
The seven shillings were already set by. John counted them down.
The foul papers stay in the coffer.
Richard knows. He has the pearwood glass, and he means to keep it.
